NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 - Complete Details

Short Information : Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has invited online applications for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class XI (2027- 28) on the official website of the NVS recently. Online registration process for NVS Class 11th Admission 2027 has started from 02 September 2026. The last date to apply for the NVS Class 11th Admission 2027 is 30 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NVS Class 11th Admission Form 2027 which has given below. below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 10 April 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • There is no Application Fee for all categories

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027?

NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 30 September 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://navodaya.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
